$Comment: Old Jack's Favor: the name, picture and limits of the game's reputation group of the same id
Cap is the most favor earning can reach: Exalted's floor, so Jack's Own is as far as it goes.
Ranks renames the library's ranks for Old Jack alone; a rank left out keeps the library's name.
Order places him on the Reputation page. Favor comes from the Reputation rewards on his quests
and board contracts, from his daily board line, and from the Horseman's Hoard on the normal ride
(Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json). The Jack Helm and the Burning Jack Helm raise
each of those gains by a percent while worn, through the stat ReputationGain_Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack
(Entity/Stats), which the library finds by this file's id; the Cap still applies. Earn lists
the ways to earn favor, one lang key a line, for the How to earn block on the Reputation page.
